verdict.rationale: Justworks' docs say it collects employees' filing status, withholding, and exemption information when they enroll, so they don't need to file a W-4 themselves. That covers the W-4 piece through employee self-enrollment. Nothing in the pack shows an ops user sending a new hire an onboarding invite, collecting I-9 verification, or capturing bank/direct-deposit details before the start date. Missing for 10: evidence of an ops-initiated self-serve invite flow, I-9 collection, bank details capture, pre-day-one completion, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
